'''''Life''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith lore]] that was part of [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok's]] collection. All words appeared in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters and were in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].
